title: Sɔhwɛ a Ɛwɔ Asorɔkye Ase
intro: Odiyifo bi a n’asɛmpatrɛw adwuma no ayɛ no adesoa no sii gyinae bi a ɛde no kɔɔ akyirikyiri fii ne nkurɔfo ho na ɔkɔɔ sɔhwɛ bi a na wɔnhwɛ kwan mu. N’akwantu no danee wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nwonwa so, sɔɔ ne gyidi ne ne boasetɔ hwɛe wɔ ɔkwan a emu dɔ sen biara so. So wubetumi afi nsɛnkyerɛnne a wɔde ama no mu ahu adeyɛ soronko yi ho nsɛm?
clues: Wɔsomaa odiyifoɔ bi kɔɔ nkurɔfoɔ bi nkyɛn, nanso ɔde ahopere kɔeɛ, na ɔtee abasamtuo nka wɔ wɔn a wɔpoo no ho.
N’akwantu no de no kɔɔ po no mu, faako a ɔforoo po so hyɛn bi a emu yɛ duru hwehwɛɛ kwan.
Ahum kɛse bi sɔree, na ɛde hyɛn no too asiane mu, na wosii gyinae sɛ wɔbɛtow onipa biako agu po no mu na ama adesoa no ayɛ hare, na wɔde ntonto sii gyinae.
Abɔde bi a ɔwɔ bun mu menee no, anwonwade a esii a Ɔsoro apɛde na ɛhyɛɛ ho mmara.
Wɔ abɔdeɛ no yafunu mu no, ɔfrɛɛ n’Awurade, na ɔsakyerae na ɔhyɛɛ Allah animuonyam wɔ esum mu.
Bere a wɔsrɛɛ no ​​denneennen akyi no, wɔtow no guu mpoano a ɛso yɛ kwae so, na na ɔyɛ mmerɛw nanso na ɔte ase, na akyiri yi ɔsan bae behui sɛ awiei koraa no ne nkurɔfo agye adi.

outcome.answer: Sane a ɔbɛsan akɔ ne nkurɔfo a saa bere no wogye dii no nkyɛn

verse: And [mention] Dhun-Nun, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. But he called out within the darknesses, 'There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.' (Al-Anbiya 21:87)
arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
